recipes.name: Anima
recipes.description: Supports all Anima variants supported by sd.cpp. Use a compatible Qwen Image VAE or TAE; adjust generation settings for distilled variants.

recipes.name: Anima Edit (LoRA)
recipes.description: Requires a matching community editing LoRA. Apply it after loading and supply reference images; uses the cosmos_reference preset.

recipes.name: AnimateDiff SD 1.5
recipes.description: Use Video Generation with an SD 1.5 checkpoint and compatible motion module.

recipes.name: Boogu Image Edit
recipes.description: Supply reference images. The separate vision projector is needed only when it is not bundled in the text encoder.

slots.label: Vision projector (required for separate GGUF text encoders)

recipes.name: Chroma Radiance
recipes.description: Pixel-space generation without a VAE. Also accepts the x0 and experimental patch-32 variants.

recipes.name: CosXL Edit
recipes.description: Supply the image to edit as a reference image.

recipes.name: Fibo 2.0 Dev
recipes.description: Text-to-image generation and native reference-image editing. Select a separate vision projector for editing when it is not bundled in the text encoder.

slots.label: Vision projector (required for separate GGUF text encoders)

recipes.name: Fibo 2.0 Edit Turbo
recipes.description: Dedicated reference-image editing checkpoint; supply reference images. Select a separate vision projector when it is not bundled in the text encoder.

slots.label: Vision projector (required for separate GGUF text encoders)

recipes.name: FLUX.1 Canny dev
recipes.description: Select Canny weights and supply a precomputed edge map as Control Image. Edge detection is not performed by this recipe.

recipes.name: FLUX.1 Depth dev
recipes.description: Select Depth weights and supply a precomputed depth map as Control Image. Depth estimation is not performed by this recipe.

recipes.name: FLUX.1 dev
recipes.description: Supports FLUX.1 dev and compatible layer-count variants such as FLUX.1 Lite. Select the transformer with matching CLIP-L, T5XXL and FLUX.1 VAE.

recipes.name: FLUX.1 Fill dev
recipes.description: Select Fill weights and supply Init Image plus Mask Image for inpainting. Denoising strength defaults to 1 for a full denoising schedule.

recipes.name: FLUX.1 Kontext dev
recipes.description: Select FLUX.1 Kontext weights. Supports text-to-image and native reference-image editing; an editing LoRA is not required.

recipes.name: FLUX.1 dev PuLID
recipes.description: Supply a precomputed PuLID identity embedding with the generation request.

recipes.name: FLUX.2 dev
recipes.description: Supports text-to-image and reference-image editing.

recipes.name: FLUX.2 Klein 4B
recipes.description: Supports reference-image editing. The FLUX.2 small decoder is an alternative VAE.

recipes.name: FLUX.2 Klein 9B
recipes.description: Supports text-to-image and reference-image editing.

recipes.name: FLUX.2 Klein Base 4B
recipes.description: Supports text-to-image and reference-image editing.

recipes.name: FLUX.2 Klein Base 9B
recipes.description: Use the 9B base transformer with Qwen 3 8B. Supports reference-image editing.

recipes.name: FLUX.3 Image Klein
recipes.description: Supports text-to-image and reference-image editing.

recipes.name: HiDream O1 Image dev
recipes.description: Bundled checkpoint; also supports reference-image editing.

recipes.name: HunyuanVideo 1.5 I2V
recipes.description: Select HunyuanVideo 1.5 I2V weights and supply a start image in Video Generation.

recipes.name: HunyuanVideo 1.5 T2V
recipes.description: Select HunyuanVideo 1.5 T2V weights and use Video Generation. Use the separate I2V recipe for I2V weights.

recipes.name: HyperFlow H3 Flash FL2VA
recipes.description: Generate video and audio from text, optionally with start/end images. Use the HyperFlow H3 Flash FL2VA transformer. Reuses MiniMax-H3 components with either the MiniMax-H3 Qwen3-VL-32B text encoder or Qwen3-VL-4B with the P-H3 text connector and the HyperFlow 6-step schedule. Audio VAE is optional for silent video.

slots.label: MiniMax-H3 Qwen 3 VL 32B or P-H3 Qwen 3 VL 4B Text Encoder
Vision tower (when not included in the text encoder)
P-H3 Text Connector (for Qwen 3 VL 4B, when not included in the text encoder)

recipes.name: HyperFlow H3 Flash Ref2VA
recipes.description: Generate video and audio with reference images. Use the HyperFlow H3 Flash Ref2VA transformer; video/audio references are not validated for these weights. Reuses MiniMax-H3 components with either the MiniMax-H3 Qwen3-VL-32B text encoder or Qwen3-VL-4B with the P-H3 text connector and the HyperFlow 6-step schedule. Reference images need the matching vision tower. Audio VAE is optional for silent video.

slots.label: MiniMax-H3 Qwen 3 VL 32B or P-H3 Qwen 3 VL 4B Text Encoder
Vision tower (required for reference images when not included in the text encoder)
P-H3 Text Connector (for Qwen 3 VL 4B, when not included in the text encoder)

recipes.name: Ideogram 4
recipes.description: Select the matching unconditional transformer for classifier-free guidance.

recipes.name: Instruct-Pix2Pix
recipes.description: Supply the image to edit as a reference image.

recipes.name: Iris 3B
recipes.description: Pixel-space model; no VAE is required.

recipes.name: Krea 2 Raw
recipes.description: For reference-image editing with a community LoRA, use the corresponding Krea 2 Edit recipe.

recipes.name: Krea 2 Raw Edit (LoRA)
recipes.description: Requires a matching Ostris-compatible community editing LoRA. Apply it after loading and supply reference images; uses the krea2_ostris_edit preset. Select a separate vision projector when it is not bundled in the text encoder.

slots.label: Vision projector (required for separate GGUF text encoders)

recipes.name: Krea 2 Turbo
recipes.description: For reference-image editing with a community LoRA, use the corresponding Krea 2 Edit recipe.

recipes.name: Krea 2 Turbo Edit (LoRA)
recipes.description: Requires a matching Ostris-compatible community editing LoRA. Apply it after loading and supply reference images; uses the krea2_ostris_edit preset. Select a separate vision projector when it is not bundled in the text encoder.

slots.label: Vision projector (required for separate GGUF text encoders)

recipes.name: LingBot Video Dense 1.3B
recipes.description: Use Video Generation.

recipes.name: LingBot Video MoE 30B A3B
recipes.description: Use Video Generation.

recipes.name: LLaDA Image (base)
recipes.description: Use matching base transformer, text encoder and connectors; do not mix them with Turbo components. Editing needs connectors with SigVQ and 1024x1024 output.

recipes.name: LLaDA Image Turbo
recipes.description: Use matching turbo text encoder and connectors. Editing needs connectors that include the SigVQ encoder.

recipes.name: LongCat Image Edit
recipes.description: Supply reference images for editing.

recipes.name: LTX 2.3 dev
recipes.description: Supports text, start-image and start/end-image video. Audio VAE is optional for silent video. Configure latent upscaling separately in generation settings. Optional distillation LoRAs use this recipe; select the LoRA and adjust the sampling settings separately.

recipes.name: LTX 2.3 Distilled 1.1
recipes.description: Supports text, start-image and start/end-image video. Audio VAE is optional for silent video. Configure latent upscaling separately in generation settings.

recipes.name: LTX 2.5 dev
recipes.description: Use the conv video VAE and LTX-specific Gemma 4 with bundled projection. Audio VAE is optional for silent video.

recipes.name: Mage Flow Edit
recipes.description: Supply reference images. Select a separate vision projector when it is not bundled in the text encoder.

slots.label: Vision projector (required for separate GGUF text encoders)

recipes.name: MiniMax H3 FL2VA
recipes.description: Generate video and audio, optionally with start/end images. Supports full and pruned FL2VA weights with either the MiniMax-H3 Qwen3-VL-32B text encoder or Qwen3-VL-4B with the P-H3 text connector. Audio VAE is optional for silent video.

slots.label: MiniMax-H3 Qwen 3 VL 32B or P-H3 Qwen 3 VL 4B Text Encoder
Vision tower (when not included in the text encoder)
P-H3 Text Connector (for Qwen 3 VL 4B, when not included in the text encoder)

recipes.name: MiniMax H3 Image
recipes.description: Text-to-image and reference-image editing with the six-step PDD checkpoint. Requires the MiniMax-H3-Image 2D VAE and either the MiniMax-H3 Qwen3-VL-32B text encoder with its vision tower or the smaller P-H3-Image text encoder (Qwen3-VL-4B with the P-H3 text connector).

slots.label: MiniMax-H3 Qwen 3 VL 32B or P-H3 Qwen 3 VL 4B Text Encoder
Vision tower (required when not included in the text encoder)
P-H3 Text Connector (for Qwen 3 VL 4B, when not included in the text encoder)

recipes.name: MiniMax H3 Ref2VA
recipes.description: Supply image, video or audio references with compatible Ref2VA weights. Use either the MiniMax-H3 Qwen3-VL-32B text encoder or Qwen3-VL-4B with the P-H3 text connector. Image/video references need the matching vision tower. Audio VAE is optional for silent video.

slots.label: MiniMax-H3 Qwen 3 VL 32B or P-H3 Qwen 3 VL 4B Text Encoder
Vision tower (required for image/video references when not included in the text encoder)
P-H3 Text Connector (for Qwen 3 VL 4B, when not included in the text encoder)

recipes.name: MiniT2I
recipes.description: Pixel-space model; no VAE is required.

recipes.name: MOSS Image Base
recipes.description: Select the MOSS-Image-Base transformer with its matching text encoder and FLUX.2 VAE or TAE.

recipes.name: MOSS Image SFT
recipes.description: Select the MOSS-Image-SFT transformer with its matching text encoder and FLUX.2 VAE or TAE.

recipes.name: P-H3-Image
recipes.description: Supports text-to-image and reference-image editing with the fixed 8-step schedule. Use the P-H3 single-frame VAE and either Qwen3-VL-4B with the P-H3 text connector or the MiniMax-H3 Qwen3-VL-32B text encoder. Reference images need the matching vision tower.

slots.label: MiniMax-H3 Qwen 3 VL 32B or P-H3 Qwen 3 VL 4B Text Encoder
Vision projector (required when not included in the text encoder)
P-H3 Text Connector (for Qwen 3 VL 4B, when not included in the text encoder)

recipes.name: PiD (Flux / Z-Image VAE)

recipes.name: PiD 1.5 (Flux / Z-Image VAE)
recipes.description: Supply a reference image; the first image is used as the source latent. Select a Flux/Z-Image PiD checkpoint and matching Flux VAE.

recipes.name: PiD 1.5 (Flux.2 VAE)
recipes.description: Supply a reference image; the first image is used as the source latent. Select a matching Flux.2 PiD checkpoint and VAE.

recipes.name: PiD 1.5 (Qwen Image VAE)

recipes.name: PiD 1.5 (SD3 VAE)
recipes.description: Supply a reference image; the first image is used as the source latent. Select a matching SD3 PiD checkpoint and VAE.

recipes.name: PiD (Flux.2 VAE)
recipes.description: Supply a reference image; the first image is used as the source latent. Select a matching Flux.2 PiD checkpoint and VAE.

recipes.name: PiD (Qwen Image VAE)
recipes.description: Supply a reference image; the first image is used as the source latent. Select a matching Qwen Image PiD checkpoint and VAE. Use the Qwen Image 2D VAE.

recipes.name: PiD (SD3 VAE)
recipes.description: Supply a reference image; the first image is used as the source latent. Select a matching SD3 PiD checkpoint and VAE.

recipes.name: PixArt Alpha XL 1024
recipes.description: Use the matching PixArt Alpha transformer and SD 1.x-style VAE. Resolution/aspect-ratio micro-conditioning is not currently applied by the runtime.

recipes.name: PixArt Alpha XL 512
recipes.description: Use the matching PixArt Alpha transformer and SD 1.x-style VAE. Resolution/aspect-ratio micro-conditioning is not currently applied by the runtime.

recipes.name: Qwen Image Edit 2509
recipes.description: Supply reference images. Select a vision projector for GGUF text encoders; omit it if vision weights are included in the text encoder.

recipes.name: Qwen Image Edit 2511
recipes.description: Supply reference images. Select a vision projector for GGUF text encoders; omit it if vision weights are included in the text encoder.

slots.label: Vision projector (required for separate GGUF text encoders)

recipes.name: Qwen Image Layered
recipes.description: Supply a reference image and use the dedicated layered VAE.

recipes.name: SD Turbo
recipes.description: Select a single-file SD-Turbo checkpoint. Uses one step with CFG disabled (scale 1 in sd.cpp); use more steps for partial image-to-image denoising.

recipes.name: SD 1.x
recipes.description: Supports SD 1.x, compatible LCM checkpoints and layer-count variants. For LCM weights, select LCM sampling and adjust steps/CFG. Tiny SD Diffusers directories must first be converted into a single-file checkpoint.

recipes.name: SD 1.5 ControlNet
recipes.description: Supply a control image; input image and mask are optional for image-to-image or inpainting.

recipes.name: SD 1.5 Inpainting
recipes.description: Select an inpainting checkpoint, then supply an input image and mask.

recipes.name: SD 1.5 IP-Adapter / Plus
recipes.description: Select matching SD 1.5 IP-Adapter or Plus weights and CLIP Vision H, then supply an IP-Adapter image.

recipes.name: SD 2.1 512
recipes.description: Supports SD 2.x 512 and compatible layer-count variants. Tiny SD2 Diffusers directories must first be converted into a single-file checkpoint.

recipes.name: SD 2 Inpainting
recipes.description: Select an inpainting checkpoint, then supply Init Image and Mask Image.

recipes.name: SD 3 Medium
recipes.description: Checkpoint with CLIP-L, CLIP-G and T5 included.

recipes.name: SDXL
recipes.description: Supports SDXL and compatible reduced-depth checkpoints such as SSD-1B and Segmind Vega.

recipes.name: SDXL ControlNet
recipes.description: Select a compatible SDXL ControlNet and supply a preprocessed control image. Input image and mask are optional for image-to-image or inpainting.

recipes.name: SDXL Inpainting
recipes.description: Select an inpainting checkpoint, then supply Init Image and Mask Image.

recipes.name: SDXL IP-Adapter / Plus
recipes.description: Select matching SDXL ViT-H IP-Adapter or Plus weights and CLIP Vision H, then supply an IP-Adapter image.

recipes.name: SDXL PhotoMaker
recipes.description: Select PhotoMaker v1 and supply identity images. Include the img trigger in the prompt.

recipes.name: SenseNova U1.5
recipes.description: Bundled MoT checkpoint.

recipes.name: Wan 2.1 FLF2V 14B
recipes.description: Select FLF2V weights and supply both start and end images.

recipes.name: Wan 2.1 I2V
recipes.description: Image-to-video with Wan 2.1, compatible SkyReels V2 weights, or a single Wan 2.2 I2V expert. CLIP Vision is required by Wan 2.1 I2V and is unused by Wan 2.2. Defaults target Wan 2.1 480p.

recipes.name: Wan 2.1 T2V
recipes.description: Text-to-video with Wan 2.1 or a compatible single Wan 2.2 T2V expert. Defaults target Wan 2.1 14B; adjust settings for the selected weights and acceleration LoRAs.

recipes.name: Wan 2.1 VACE 1.3B / 14B
recipes.description: Select matching VACE weights. Supports text, reference images and control video through Video Generation.

recipes.name: Wan 2.2 I2V A14B
recipes.description: Image-to-video. Select a start image in Video Generation after loading. LightX2V acceleration LoRAs must match the I2V low- and high-noise models; configure LoRAs and sampling separately.

recipes.name: Wan 2.2 S2V 14B
recipes.description: Supply a start image and reference audio through Video Generation.

recipes.name: Wan 2.2 T2V A14B
recipes.description: Text-to-video. Use Video Generation after loading. LightX2V acceleration LoRAs must match the T2V low- and high-noise models; configure LoRAs and sampling separately.

recipes.name: Wan 2.2 TI2V 5B
recipes.description: Use Wan 2.2 VAE. Supports text, start-image and start/end-image conditioning.

recipes.name: Z-Image L2P
recipes.description: Pixel-space L2P checkpoint with Qwen 3 4B; no VAE is needed. Use dimensions divisible by 16.
